room: The forest path narrows into shadow. Twisted roots cross the trail and a faint ozone smell lingers — packets, perhaps, leaking from a broken node downstream.
A rough-hewn track at the wood's edge. The trees lean inward; somewhere ahead, a stream rattles over stones.
pre: A {enemies[0].name} skitters out from beneath the roots and bares its teeth.
Movement in the leaves — a {enemies[0].name} drops onto the trail in front of you.
You hear claws on bark. A {enemies[0].name} circles in from the side.
post: The path ahead clears. Something else is watching from deeper in.
Silence. You wipe your hands on your robe and continue.
The forest exhales. A crow lifts off, far away, then nothing.

room: A ruined stone archway, half-swallowed by ivy. The keystone bears a glyph that shifts when you don't look directly at it.
What was a gatehouse is now four crumbling pillars and a wedge of ivy. The wind here smells of old paper.
pre: A {enemies[0].name} hisses from behind the archway and lunges.
Out of the ivy lurches a {enemies[0].name}, eyes flat and bright.
post: The archway is quiet again. The glyph on the keystone has stopped shifting.
You stand panting beneath the arch. The ivy stirs, then is still.

room: The trail dips into a sour-smelling marsh. Reeds taller than a man flank the only passable path.
Black water on both sides of a narrow causeway. Insects spell out little patterns above the surface and disperse.
pre: The reeds part — a {enemies[0].name} bursts toward you in a spray of muck.
A {enemies[0].name} explodes out of the marsh water, spitting weeds and venom.
post: The reeds settle. Frogsong returns somewhere far off.
The marsh resumes its slow breathing. You squelch onward.

scene.room: Small goblin camp at the edge of a moss-eaten clearing. Embers pop in a stone-ringed firepit; a half-eaten haunch turns slowly on a spit.
pre: A bunch of goblins sit calmly around the campfire. They notice you, jump to their feet, and attack.
Around the fire, a {enemies[0].name} is mid-laugh when it sees you. The laugh turns into a war-cry.
post: All enemies lie sprawled around the dying fire. The spit creaks once, twice, then stops.
The camp is yours. The fire pops once, mournfully, and gutters.

scene.room: A pocket of hostile traffic. Stale air, the green light of error logs.
pre: Hostile processes lock onto your handle.
A {enemies[0].name} snaps into focus and lunges.
post: The room is yours. The error logs go quiet.

scene.room: Heavy traffic congeals here. The walls of the node are slick with packet residue.
scene.pre: Something larger than the rest stirs at the back of the room and turns to face you.
scene.post: The hostile process collapses into noise. The room exhales.

scene.room: The SYSOP's chamber. Every surface is a screen, every screen shows you.
scene.pre: The SYSOP turns, very slowly, and acknowledges your handle for the first time.
scene.post: The SYSOP's avatar dissolves. The screens go to snow.

room: A pocket of static calm — a quiet glade where the BBS hum drops to a whisper.
A small clearing where the connection feels almost clean. Something old has been kept here.

scene.room: An archive node. Directories nest into directories; some are intact, most are not.
A small storefront in the network — a flickering ANSI sign reads WARES, all caps.
Something irregular hums in this node. The packets here travel sideways.
